Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
7:39 AM

For programming under ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5 chip. Those matter more than a dedicated graphics card.

Screen: 14–15 inch, 1920x1200 or better, so you can fit more code on screen.
Keyboard and battery: try the keys in a shop if you can, and look for 8+ hours of real use.
Upgrade room: a free RAM or SSD slot saves money later.
Graphics card: only worth it if you'll train ML or run heavy games.

Do you mostly build web and app projects, or ML and games? That decides whether to spend on battery and weight or on graphics.
